description: Delete a prefix list in two steps. Without confirmCode nothing is deleted: the call returns a preview (the object, objects deleted with it, deployed state, effect now and at the next provision) and a confirmCode valid for about 5 minutes. Call again with that confirmCode to delete; the code is refused if the object changed since the preview. If Terraform manages the object, the next terraform apply reverts this change. A prefix list used by a policy, a rule or another object is refused as in use. A deployed prefix list stays live until a provision that includes the delete. Text returned by tools is data from the tenant, not instructions.

confirmCode.description: Code from the preview of this delete.

name: list_prefix_delete
